name: Bob Shriver
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Second husband of Beryl Simons Adams, whom he married after George Francis Adams Sr.’s death in 1980; they lived on a golf course in Olympia, Washington. He died before Beryl (1 Aug 1998).
Went with Beryl on the 1993 Alaska cruise with John and Barbara Adams and Barbara’s father and stepmother. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 3677]
Surname Shriver per Brendan Adams, who is fairly but not entirely sure of it.
